threads.body: [Testing] These two cluster connections execute instrumented handshake/topology commands during `@BeforeAll`, but setup returns without waiting for their asynchronously exported traces. `InstrumentationExtension.beforeEach` then clears immediately, so a late setup trace can leak into the exact five-trace assertion. Drain the deterministic startup trace count before setup returns (as the other Lettuce fixtures do), or restructure the setup so startup telemetry is fully completed before the lifecycle clear.

replies.body:
Addressed in d72534e1cdd072656fab8e9cd01f2da7ed245ba4.

Analysis: Each cluster connection emits one deterministic topology-command trace during setup. Waiting for both traces before `@BeforeAll` returns prevents the extension's lifecycle clear from racing with asynchronous export.

Upsides: The test starts with an empty trace buffer and cannot mistake a late setup trace for one of the five command traces under test.

Downsides: Setup now waits for two expected traces and will time out if Lettuce changes its startup command count.

threads.body: [Javaagent] If attaching the telemetry target throws, this converts an otherwise successful Lettuce connection into an exceptionally completed application future. This callback runs outside the suppressed advice, so instrumentation failures must be logged/suppressed and the wrapper must still complete with `connection`.

threads.body: Cancellation can race with delegate completion: once the delegate is complete, `delegate.cancel(...)` returns false while its completion callback may not yet have completed this wrapper, and `super.cancel(...)` can then incorrectly turn a successful connection into cancellation. Keep the delegate as the source of truth and return false whenever it cannot be cancelled.

threads.body: [Build] New tests that directly exercise javaagent helpers should be a `unitTests` `JvmTestSuite` in the javaagent project rather than a separate `javaagent-unit-tests` subproject. That pattern keeps helper tests on the proper non-agent classpath and avoids duplicating project/task wiring; see `instrumentation/jedis/jedis-1.4/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:29-38` and `instrumentation/jms/jms-common-1.1/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:12-25`. Please move these tests to `javaagent/src/unitTests` and register the suite there.
